subject: ing
title: Three conjugations: -ar, -er, -ir (present, Spanish verbs in English)

points.heading: First conjugation (-ar / cantar)
points.body:
Spanish -ar verbs are the first conjugation. Remove -ar and add endings: -o, -as, -a, -amos, -áis, -an.

Present indicative: I sing = yo canto; you sing = tú cantas; he/she sings = él canta. Cantar is the model.

Examples: hablar → hablo, hablas, habla; estudiar → estudio, estudias, estudia.

Common mistake: keeping -ar on yo (wrong: yo cantar). Right: yo canto.

points.heading: Second conjugation (-er / comer)
points.body:
Second conjugation ends in -er. Endings: -o, -es, -e, -emos, -éis, -en.

I eat = yo como; you eat = tú comes; he/she eats = yo come. Comer is the model.

Examples: beber → bebo, bebes, bebe; leer → leo, lees, lee.

Do not use -ar endings on -er verbs.

points.heading: Third conjugation (-ir / vivir)
points.body:
Third conjugation ends in -ir. Endings: -o, -es, -e, -imos, -ís, -en.

I live = yo vivo; you live = tú vives; he/she lives = él vive. Vivir is the model.

Examples: escribir → escribo, escribes, escribe; abrir → abro, abres, abre.

Watch -imos (we) vs -emos from -er verbs.

lesson.summary: Recognize Spanish -ar, -er, -ir present forms (I/you/he) using cantar, comer, vivir.
